entry.title: Page updated: Maine Board of Bar Examiners — Announcements — Maine Board of Bar Examiners — Announcements
entry.content:
This page's content changed since the last check. Visit the page directly to review the update.
What changed (text excerpt): Added: + Announcements + Posted: March 11, 2025 + FEE INCREASE FOR ALL APPLICATIONS BEGINNING MARCH 15, 2025 + The Maine Supreme Judicial Court has increased the fees for all applications made to the Maine Board of Bar Examiners. The amendment to the Maine Bar Admission Rules can be found at the following link: + 2025_mr_01_bar_admission_2025-03-07.pdf + This increase will take effect for all applications received for the July 2025 Maine Bar Exam, and all applications for Admission by Motion and UBE Score Transfer that arrive in the office beginning on March 15, 2025. The new fees that will begin on March 15, 2025 are as follows: + Maine Bar Exam Application Fees: + Applicants Never Admitted in Any Jurisdiction or Admitted in Another Jurisdiction for Less than One Year – $800 + Applicants Admitted in Another Jurisdiction for One Year or More: $900 (plus NCBE Character and Fitness Application fee paid directly to NCBE) + Admission by Motion Application Fee: + $1000 (plus NCBE Character and Fitness Application fee paid directly to NCBE) + UBE Score + Transfer Application Fees: + Applicants Seeking Admission Pursuant to Rule 11B Not Admitted in Another Jurisdiction for a Year or More: $900 + Applicants Seeking Admission Pursuant to Rule 11B Admitted in Another Jurisdiction for a Year or More: $1000 (plus the NCBE Character and Fitness Application fee paid directly to NCBE) + Posted: January 23, 2025 + JULY 2028 ADOPTION OF NEXTGEN BAR EXAM + T [diff truncated]

What changed (text excerpt): Added: + 8/24/2026 + In re: Elizabeth E. LaPierre + Single Justice + Receiver Appointment [PDF] + Order for Appointment of Receiver + 8/24/2026 + Board of Overseers of the Bar v. Elizabeth E. LaPierre, of Portland, Maine + Single Justice + Immediate Interim Suspension [PDF] + Suspension Removed: - FY27 Annual Attorney Registration is Open - Attorney license renewal and Guardian ad Litem license renewal may be completed in the MyBoardAccess portal from July 1 through August 31, 2026 at 5:00 pm. - Pursuant to M. Bar R. 4, - Registration documents and payments received after August 31st will be assessed a non-waivable late fee. - We greatly appreciate your updated contact information, proxy, and IOLTA account listing, and service email for court service and notices. - If your status has changed since last year: - new law clerk - clerkship ended or is ending soon - retired seeking to be Inactive - new judge - no longer a judge - active military or changing status - seeking to become active again - Before you register in the portal, please contact - execassistant@mebaroverseers.org - to request a status change. - Please note, if you still owe a CLE late fee your license renewal/registration cannot be approved until that is resolved. - Registration is completed online on the - MyBoardAccess - by clicking on the Renew Registration section of the Board's web portal. A confirmation email will automatically be sent to you from [diff truncated]
